svg.aria-label: The four delays a packet meets at each router: processing (check header, pick output), queuing (wait behind other packets), transmission (push all bits onto the link, size divided by bandwidth) and propagation (travel along the wire at about two thirds the speed of light).
svg.title: The four delays a packet meets at each router: processing (check header, pick output), queuing (wait behind other packets), transmission (push all bits onto the link, size divided by bandwidth) and propagation (travel along the wire at about two thirds the speed of light).
svg.text: push all bits onto the link
Example: 1,500-byte packet on a 100 Mb/s link = 0.12 ms to transmit; 1,000 km of fibre = 5 ms to propagate.
